title: Yes Bank Prosperity Business credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Prosperity Business card designed for SMEs and entrepreneurs, offering cashback on utilities, travel, and business spends, with milestone vouchers and expense management features.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: 1 golf lesson every calendar month and 4 additional sessions with green fee waiverd at select golf courses in India.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Credit shield cover of INR 3 Lakhs on accidental death of Primary Cardmember. Lost card liability cover of INR 3 Lakhs.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to YES BANK Customer Care at 1800 103 6000 or 022 4935 0000. For email support, contact yesfirstcc@yesbank.in
